America is preparing for the midterm elections. But there is another contest happening behind the scenes - one involving billions of dollars.
The 2026 midterms are on track to become the most expensive in US history. Billionaires, corporations and political groups are pouring money into key races. And one name stands out: Elon Musk.
So, who is spending all this money? Where is it going? And what does it mean for American democracy?
